title: Research: certify complete multi-donor R439 star absorption linear system and gain-0 chaining (no new kappa)
head: 8b4a4d59eb5df9971d44587d9980c3dd0b18fc96
body:
## Summary

**Scoped replacement-interface census and linear-algebraic exclusion; no new $\kappa$.** Prepared by **Aaron Wang**, with help from opencode. Apache-2.0. Only `research/r439-multi-donor-star-absorption/` is added; `certificates/selected-result.json`, the selected bit supplier (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/589), and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Under the twisted helper contract (`H2-tw / H4-tw / K-tw` of Sagar Thakrar's [PR #1868](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1868), head `6b222d01fee072bcd3a680e6a96ae7d22e13bcac`), omitting a nonempty subset $L_a$ of terminal `D` helper-star restorations on a centre $a$ and toggling source/helper donors across existing pre-first-read `A` writes $W(a)$ restores $a$ before its first read.

This preserves the exact 661-column arbitrary-dirty boundary

$$
(x,y,h)\longmapsto(x,y+x,h)
$$

with unchanged literal `C` **if and only if** the binary indicator vector $c\in\mathbb{F}_2^{\lvert P(a)\rvert}$ over the frame-legal donor pool

$$
P(a)=\lbrace (i,r):i\in W(a),\ r\text{ legal at }A[i]\rbrace
$$

satisfies

$$
\sum_{(i,r)\in P(a)}c_{i,r}\thinspace\mathrm{val}_i[r]
=d_a
\quad\text{in }\mathbb{F}_2^{661},
$$

where

$$
d_a=\bigoplus_{b\in L_a}e_b.
$$

The exact net scalar ADD change is

$$
\Delta\mathrm{ADDs}(c)
=-\lvert L_a\rvert+
\sum_{(i,r)\in P(a)}w_{i,r}c_{i,r},
$$

with

$$
w_{i,r}=
\begin{cases}
-1 & \text{if }r\in S_i,\\
+1 & \text{if }r\notin S_i.
\end{cases}
$$

Open [PR #1868](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1868) tested single-writer substitutions and left open multi-gate splits of $S$ and chaining the gain-0 moves. Open [PR #1913](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1913) (Adam Gall, head `6cde2d14f0090f51672feae32a04f3145e70f595`) excluded two-writer single-donor-per-writer corrections ($\lvert D_i\rvert=\lvert D_j\rvert=1$) on the 11,500-ADD word and left open arbitrary multi-donor correction sets over full-itinerary-legal donors.

## Exact results across three pinned R439 star words

The package evaluates three pinned candidate words:

- **`pr967`**: `research/r439-helper-stars-seed19/candidate.json.gz` (11,783 ADDs, 221 edges, 157 centres).
- **`pr1062`**: `research/r439-bsection-stars-seed01/candidate.json.gz` (11,500 ADDs, 236 edges, 162 centres).
- **`pr1122`**: `research/r439-abc-semantic-bridge/inputs/candidate.json.gz` (10,652 ADDs, 236 edges, 162 centres).

For each word, the package solves the complete unconstrained-size multi-donor, multi-writer $\mathbb{F}_2$-linear system across all pre-first-read writes, with $1\le\lvert W(a)\rvert\le5$, in two modes:

- **`same_path`**: Full-itinerary-legal donors, keeping all 661 register frame paths and paid profile `{1:1323, 2:1342, 3:79, 4:44, 5:102, 6:11, 7:19}` identical.
- **`monotone_all`**: All fixed-gate monotone-climb-legal donors.

### Donor-pool census

| Word | Mode | Star edges | Two-leaf centres | Pool pairs | Zero-bit $b$ | Nonzero-bit unsolvable |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `pr967` (11,783) | `same_path` | 221 | 64 | 1,287 | 147 | 69 |
| `pr967` (11,783) | `monotone_all` | 221 | 64 | 1,744 | 146 | 70 |
| `pr1062` (11,500) | `same_path` | 236 | 74 | 1,412 | 158 | 73 |
| `pr1062` (11,500) | `monotone_all` | 236 | 74 | 1,894 | 157 | 74 |
| `pr1122` (10,652) | `same_path` | 236 | 74 | 1,484 | 134 | 97 |
| `pr1122` (10,652) | `monotone_all` | 236 | 74 | 2,013 | 133 | 98 |

Pool pairs are counted as $\sum_a\lvert P(a)\rvert$.

### Solvability and exclusion results

| Word | Mode | Solvable single edges | Solvable two-leaf pairs | Extra from chaining | Dual witnesses |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `pr967` (11,783) | `same_path` | **5** | **0** | **0** | — |
| `pr967` (11,783) | `monotone_all` | **5** | **0** | **0** | 280 |
| `pr1062` (11,500) | `same_path` | **5** | **0** | **0** | — |
| `pr1062` (11,500) | `monotone_all` | **5** | **0** | **0** | 305 |
| `pr1122` (10,652) | `same_path` | **5** | **0** | **0** | — |
| `pr1122` (10,652) | `monotone_all` | **5** | **0** | **0** | 305 |

### 1. 890 canonical dual-hyperplane witnesses

Every unsolvable single-leaf target $e_b$ (216 on `pr967`, 231 on `pr1062`, 231 on `pr1122`) and every simultaneous two-leaf target $e_{b_1}\oplus e_{b_2}$ (64 on `pr967`, 74 on `pr1062`, 74 on `pr1122`) carries an explicit dual vector $u\in\mathbb{F}_2^{661}$ in `CERTIFICATE.json`.

Each witness satisfies

$$
\langle u,d_a\rangle=1\pmod 2
$$

and

$$
\langle u,\mathrm{val}_i[r]\rangle=0\pmod 2
\qquad
\text{for all }(i,r)\in P_{\mathrm{mono}}(a).
$$

All witnesses are independently checked by a frozenset oracle in `test_package.py`.

### 2. Complete affine solution spaces on the 5 solvable edges

Exhausting all $2^{\dim\ker}$ solutions proves:

| Edge | Minimum $\Delta\mathrm{ADDs}$ | Result |
|---|---:|---|
| `506 ^= 374` | **-1** | No single-edge multi-donor or multi-writer split reaches -2 ADDs |
| `507 ^= 355` | **-1** | No single-edge multi-donor or multi-writer split reaches -2 ADDs |
| `514 ^= 367` | **-1** | No single-edge multi-donor or multi-writer split reaches -2 ADDs |
| `264 ^= 536` | **0** | Writers `[38, 346]` |
| `326 ^= 530` | **0** | Writers `[98, 334]` |

### 3. Why early `monotone_all` gain-0 moves worsen the paid profile

Under `same_path`, `264 ^= 536` and `326 ^= 530` have unique solutions:

- `264 ^= 536`: `A[346]` at rank-2 frame 153.
- `326 ^= 530`: `A[334]` at rank-2 frame 147.

Both preserve all 661 frame paths and the paid profile.

Their additional `monotone_all` solutions at `A[38]` (rank-1 frame 21) and `A[98]` (rank-1 frame 51) split a `0 -> 2` climb into `0 -> 1 -> 2`.

This changes the paid profile by $-H_2+2H_1$, raising child count from **2,920 to 2,921** at fixed rank mass **5,129**.

### 4. Cross-centre chaining and 5-edge composition

Adjoining all star-leaf vectors

$$
\lbrace e_{b'}:(a',b')\in E\rbrace
$$

of any unread centre $a'\in P_{\mathrm{mono}}(a)$, with `i < first_read(a')`, yields **zero additional solvable single-leaf or two-leaf targets**. The chained pool adjoins only these original star-leaf vectors; intermediate defect vectors of in-flight multi-write corrections (twist plus partial donor-toggle sums) are generally different vectors and are not modelled, so the exclusion of cross-centre chained absorptions covers star-leaf-vector injection only.

Composing all five `same_path` edges (`composed_all_5`) passes:

- The 661-column forward/reverse literal COPY/ERASE boundary.
- `H2-tw / H4-tw / K-tw`.
- `xcheck_p.py`.

The five-edge composition has identical ADDs (**11,780**, **11,497**, **10,649**), `F / B` bounds, and paid mass **5,129** as the three-edge composition.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-multi-donor-star-absorption --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-multi-donor-star-absorption
```

Expected output:

```text
PASS_R439_MULTI_DONOR_STAR_ABSORPTION words=3 edges=221,236,236 pr1062_pools=1412/1894 solvable=5 two_leaf=0 chained_extra=0 duals=305 ADDs=11500->11497 controls=10 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/r439-multi-donor-star-absorption outcome=completed
```

## Remaining obligations and credit

**No new $\kappa$ is claimed.**

The package does not claim a selected-supplier change, native 5/9/11-stage C++/Boost replay (covered for the three-edge words by [PR #1902](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1902)), hosted emission/invoice, all-size compiler, precision/tape, or analytic transfer.

Edits that cross a read of a twisted centre and simultaneously compensate downstream reader gates remain open and are recorded in `README.md` and `TASK.json`. Corrections that consume intermediate defect vectors of in-flight multi-write corrections are likewise not covered.
